neighbours.label: a modifier saying something already exists and can be reused (adapt existing platforms, commercially available drugs)
fire: We plan to adapt existing tools and build new ones.
They repurposed commercially available sensors for the study.
Our team reused existing software for the new robot.
Doctors tested widely available drugs against the virus.
The aim is to modify existing engines for cleaner fuel.
Engineers used readily available parts from old radios.
She adapted existing models to fit the new data.
They relied on publicly available records for the survey.
quiet: We plan to sell old tools and buy new ones.
They bought expensive sensors for the study.
Our team wrote new software for the new robot.
Doctors tested many drugs against the virus.
The aim is to build new engines for cleaner fuel.
Engineers made custom parts for old radios.
She built new models to fit the data.
They collected private records for the survey.

notes: Card flags broad (1.3%): ' existing' x5, ' available' x2, ' an' x2, ' motor', ' of', 'os'. Probes: ' existing' 0.383, ' available' 0.377, ' from' 0.161; plain under 0.05. Near misses keep the sentences with new or plain adjectives.
